labels: The student's fingers curl around one backpack strap at chest height while that strap continues over the shoulder to the bag behind the back.; 학생의 손가락이 가슴 높이의 백팩 끈 하나를 감싸고 해당 끈이 어깨 너머 등 뒤 가방까지 이어진다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The student's fingers curl around one backpack strap at chest height while that strap continues over the shoulder to the bag behind the back.
aliases: 가방끈 잡기
